title: Mixed Event — Let's Study Hard! — Episode6 The Long-Awaited Test

meta.Event Outline: The end of the year is approaching at Kamiyama High School. An is headed to practice as usual when a teacher stops her and Mizuki in their tracks. That's when the pair are confronted with some hair-raising news about their prospects for the next school year.

rows.Line: The next day
Kamiyama High School - Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kamishiro! Thank you so much for teaching me that mnemonic yesterday! I think I've memorized the elements!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Really?
Well then, why not test yourself by writing them out?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Uhh... Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh no. I remembered the mnemonic, but not what any of it means!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Akito, is that a probability problem you're working on?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Do you mind not snooping on my notebook?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. I'm very au fait with that unit! I shall take this opportunity and teach you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh, no one asked you to do that... I'm fine, really.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No need to be polite! The trick to solving these is to...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's like talking to a brick wall... I guess I'll just let him teach me.
The day after that

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Rote memorization has its place in the classroom... However, you won't get far just glaring at your textbook.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's where this device comes in.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I saw that earlier... What is it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. This right here is my instantaneous memorization device. It delivers intense stimulation to all the senses to help the user instantly commit knowledge to memory.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's still an experimental prototype, but I can guarantee your safety. Would you like to try it out, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Who the heck would try that weird thing out?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I... I'm kinda...curious...
Anything to get these weird chemical formulas to stay in my brain...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: C-Calm down, Shiraishi. Organic learning is the way forward...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Man, I'm beat!
Time for a little break.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Excuse me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh, Kusanagi?
What are you still doing at school?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... I heard from Rui and Tsukasa about your study sessions.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I brought these to keep you all going. They're chocolates from this shop by the station... Feel free to share them around if you like.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I could tell Tsukasa and Rui have been working hard, and they say eating chocolate helps when you're tired.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you! You're a lifesaver!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No problem... Good luck with studying.
Last day of supplementary classes

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It looks like everyone's here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Today's the day...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is it. Everything hinges on whether you can pass this test.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you feel prepared?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Of course I do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How hard do you think I've been working for this? I'm not about to crumble at the last hurdle.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah... Yes, I feel the same.
Also...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I owe it to the three of you for all you've done to help us out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm gonna give it all I've got.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha. I guess I need to treat this test seriously too. After all, I want to go into second year too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes! Well then...
Let's all be sure to pass this test...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: ...and make it into the next year!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright...
We're going in!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay. Good luck, all of you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Do you think they'll be alright?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have every confidence.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You saw for yourself, Aoyagi, how much effort they put into studying each day.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By this point, they can surpass any obstacle in their way. All you and I can do now...is have faith and be patient.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're right.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Does everyone have their test?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Some of you are being tested for more subjects than others, so please submit your tests to me when you finish.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I will grade you immediately and inform you of your results before you leave.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I want you to show your best efforts and not let the past week go to waste.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: You may begin.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Yes! That's chemistry out of the way. And I hardly had trouble with any questions...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But now it's classics... I've gotta focus.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Okay, it's going well.
I understand everything so far...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (There are two sections... The first is Literary Chinese.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (This looks okay. I've never had that much trouble with this part of classics, so I can get the gist of it...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But the second one is Classical Japanese... My Everest...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Let's take a look at the passage...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Wait! This is...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (“The chaunginge of the sesoun stirreth the pathos of thinges in alle manere wyse.”)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (“And autumpne stirreth it most of al, oft it hath bin said. Forsooth it may be so, yit nought can enflame the herte as can the seytes of springe.”)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's the essay I read on the first day of supplementary classes with everyone's help...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Okay. I can do this...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh! Sometimes, at the end of a day of singing practice, I'll feel really tired, look at the sky and think it looks gorgeous!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I understand that too! When I look at the sky after pushing myself to the limit, it always looks so vast and peaceful.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes! I know exactly what you mean!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That deeply sentimental feeling is more or less what is called “the pathos of things”.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Yeah...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The changing seasons...lend a rich charm to everything.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Everyone says that things are most charming in fall, but nothing is as moving as...the sights of spring.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (When spring is announced by birdsong and gentle sunlight, and the sprouting of shoots and buds in hedges...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I can read it.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I can visualize what the words are saying...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It doesn't sound like some weird magic words anymore. I understand the emotions behind the writing!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I can feel what the writer was feeling... What it's like to look at nature and feel sadness and beauty and a surge of emotion... The pathos of things...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I owe this to the others. Mizuki, Kamishiro, Toya... And to Akito and Tenma for studying alongside me, too.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (No, not just them. I have so many other friends who've been there for me.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Their support and kindness have kept me going...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I can do it now...! I can answer all these questions!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (An's so focused...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I've gotta pull my weight too. Right?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I owe it to them for believing in me. There's no way I'm going out there defeated...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Wait... It's over...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I guess I was really focused... It went by...so fast...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Wait, no. I should check my work...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Everything's fine...
I answered every question, and I didn't make any mistakes filling in the answer sheet.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Yeah... This should be...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Thanks, guys.
I got here thanks to you...)
